# Business idea (draft v1)

Problem: Small independent restaurants run on thin margins, but their software (POS, inventory, scheduling, supplier orders) is either expensive enterprise tooling or spreadsheets. Owners like my parents lose hours each week to manual reconciliation of supplier invoices, food cost, and staff schedules.

Idea: A simple, affordable back-office tool for 1-40 seat restaurants: ingest supplier invoices, track food cost per dish, flag price changes, and generate weekly prep/order lists.

Why me: I grew up working in my parents' 40-seat restaurant in San Jose. I'm a CS grad with Python and web dev skills, and first in my family to finish a 4-year degree.

First steps: interview 10 local restaurant owners, build a invoice-to-food-cost prototype with real invoices from my parents' restaurant, find one paying pilot.
